description: Exchange the code from the bank's redirect for a session and store it under label, replacing the consent stored there (the previous sessions.json is copied to sessions.json.bak first); without a label, a renewal replaces the stored consent for the same bank, country and psu_type. Takes the WHOLE redirect URL or just its code. The code is single-use and expires within minutes, so run this straight after the approval. The session is written to disk before anything else, because Enable Banking reveals the session id exactly once. Returns the authorised accounts (IBAN, currency, name, as the bank describes them now) and when the consent ends.

code_or_url.description: The full redirect URL (...?code=...&state=...), or the code value alone.

label.description: What to store it under: a-z, 0-9, _ and -. Default: the label of the stored consent for the same bank, country and psu_type (a renewal replaces it), else the bank and country, like example_bank_de.

name: complete_auth
title: Finish a bank consent
